item.title: Onshore Yuan Snaps Winning Streak as PBOC Lifts FX Reserve Ratio
item.description: The onshore yuan halted its longest winning streak in three decades after the People’s Bank of China moved to cool its rally by asking banks to hold more foreign currencies in reserve.

item.title: Brookfield, QIA to Invest £2.5 Billion in Drax Data Center
item.description: Brookfield Asset Management and the Qatar Investment Authority have reached an agreement to invest £2.5 billion ($3.4 billion) in a data center project with UK power generator Drax Group Plc.

item.title: Eyesan: Strong Interest in New Nigerian Oil Blocks
item.description: Nigeria is offering 40 deepwater, shallow water and onshore blocks as it seeks to attract investment in its oil industry. Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission Chief Executive Oritsemeyiwa Eyesan spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar about plans to accelerate operations and development. (Source: Bloomberg)
